title: Wheel
createMatch: Log a match for this pairing
participantsHint: Tap to sit someone out. Tap the cue to pick who spins: they leave the wheel and take a seat on the team.
modeHint1v1: Two spins; whoever is drawn is removed from the next spin.
modeHint2v2: Four spins to make two teams; whoever is drawn is removed from the next spin.
modeHint1v1v1: Three spins, everyone on their own. Whoever comes last pays the bill.
modeHintSpinner1v1: {name} spins once; whoever is drawn is the opponent.
modeHintSpinner1v1v1: {name} spins twice; both drawn are opponents. Whoever comes last pays the bill.
modeHintSpinner2v2: Whoever {name} draws joins their team. With exactly 4 players the other two are the other team; with more, keep spinning for the other team.
treatHint: Drag to set a chance; everyone else shares the rest evenly. Applies only to spins on this device, and viewers can't see it. ×N repeats names on the wheel, the victim appears once.
repeatMultiplier: Repeat names {n} times on the wheel
emptyBody: Add players in the admin area to use the wheel.
